couples.story: By the couple's own account, it started in Lyles's direct messages. Bromfield first wrote to him in 2017, and her opening question, whether he could cook, has become part of their story [1][4]. They went on a first date in 2018 and, after years of friendship and crossing paths at international meets, became a couple in 2022 [1][4]. Lyles proposed on 12 October 2024 at a surprise evening of rose petals, candles and a sign asking her to marry him, and they shared the news in a joint Instagram post the next day [1]. They married on 4 April 2026 at The Conservatory at Blackberry Ridge in Trenton, Georgia [2][3]. During the ceremony Lyles held Bromfield's vow book for her as she read her vows, and the reception included a performance by gospel singer Tasha Cobbs Leonard [2]. Lyles told Essence he had a feeling they would be an example of how a marriage grows [3].
couples.style: The wedding's theme, as Bromfield described it, was all shades of melanin, carried through in brown and gold with a glamorous finish [3][2]. Essence detailed the looks: Lyles and his groomsmen wore Musika, with styling by Kwasi Kessie, YSL ceremony shoes and Omega watches, while Bromfield wore Pantora Bridal for both ceremony and party, with her bridesmaids also dressed by Pantora [3].
couples.culture: Bromfield is a two-time Olympian for Jamaica: she won bronze in the women's 4x400m relay at the Tokyo Games and ran the individual 400m at Paris 2024 [1]. Lyles has described her as a multiple world championship medallist [1]. She holds a law degree from the University of Technology in Kingston, has built her own audience with the Instagram series Mic'd Up Junelle, and appears with Lyles in Netflix's docuseries Sprint [1].

couples.story: Mondo Duplantis and Desiré Inglander met at a Midsummer party in Sweden in 2020 [1][2]. Inglander has joked that she was not ready to mingle, and Duplantis pursued her for months until she agreed to a date before he left for the United States [1][5]. They went public on Instagram in March 2021: she posted a mirror selfie with a red heart, and a month later he followed with a photo captioned 'Du vet', Swedish for 'You know' [1]. He proposed on 9 October 2024 on the set of a Vogue Scandinavia shoot that he had used as cover for the surprise [1][3]. They married in a civil ceremony at Stockholm City Hall on 7 March 2026 [1], days before Duplantis set a new pole vault world record on 12 March [5]. In June they celebrated with a wedding weekend on the Côte d'Azur, with the ceremony at Château de Castellaras near Cannes on 12 June, and shared photos in a joint Instagram post [2][4].
couples.style: Few athlete couples are as fashion-literate. For the wedding weekend Inglander wore Ida Lanto for her silk organza ceremony gown and dinner dress, Georges Hobeika at the welcome party, Vivienne Westwood by the pool and Antoine Guérin for the after-party, while Duplantis wore Saman Amel for the ceremony and Tiger of Sweden suits [2][4]. Earlier in 2026 she wore Georges Hobeika to the Met Gala [2]. Together they have walked the red carpet for his documentary Born to Fly and attended Paris and Milan fashion weeks, including Bottega Veneta, Hermès and Dior [1].
couples.culture: Inglander is a Swedish model who has built a social media career with more than 800,000 Instagram followers [3][5]. Vogue Scandinavia made her a digital cover star in March 2026 with a bridal story in which she called her wedding 'my Olympics' [3]. She has developed gala looks with designer Ida Lanto, and her Georges Hobeika gown at the 2026 Met Gala took her onto fashion's biggest stage [2]. She regularly attends Duplantis's major competitions, and the pair have appeared together at the Laureus World Sports Awards and Sweden's Idrottsgalan [5][1].

couples.story: Dansby Swanson and Mallory Swanson, then Mallory Pugh, were introduced in 2017 on a blind date arranged by his Atlanta Braves teammate Jace Peterson, who is married to her sister [2][3]. They went Instagram official in 2018, got engaged in 2021 and married in December 2022 at the Ritz-Carlton Reynolds on Lake Oconee in Georgia, with teammates from both sports among the guests [2][3]. Within weeks Swanson signed with the Chicago Cubs, putting the shortstop in the same city as her NWSL club, the Chicago Stars [2]. Each has the biggest prizes in their sport on the shelf: he is a World Series champion, two-time All-Star and Gold Glove winner; she won the 2019 World Cup and Olympic gold in Paris in 2024 [4][2]. In 2026 their joint charity, the Purpose and Calling Foundation, became the centre of Dansby's nomination as the Cubs' candidate for the Roberto Clemente Award, which honours character and community work [1].
couples.style: Their wedding was styled as an enchanted forest, with a canopy of trees, gold star chandeliers and green and white flowers, followed by a Southern menu and a Waffle House after-party [3]. At Wrigley Field their look is pure team colours: Mallory posted couple photos from the 2025 playoffs signed off with a simple love note to Chicago [4], and when she played the first women's game at Wrigley, Dansby left flowers in a locker for her [5].
couples.culture: Mallory's Chicago Stars drew a record NWSL crowd of 35,038 to Wrigley Field in June 2024 for the first women's soccer match at the ballpark [5]. Off the field the couple run the Purpose and Calling Foundation, which works with Chicago groups on sport, education and community spaces; their Swanson Games fundraiser with Cubs and Stars teammates raised more than $700,000, and the foundation committed $200,000 to a public playground in Evanston [1].

couples.story: Tommy Paul and Paige Lorenze went public in October 2022 and became one of the most followed couples on the ATP Tour, with Lorenze a regular presence in his player box [1]. In July 2025 Paul proposed on Nantucket at a waterfront cottage surrounded by blue hydrangeas [3]. A year later, on 14 July 2026, they married at Old Westbury Gardens, a historic Gold Coast estate on Long Island, with Vogue documenting the day [3][1]. Fellow Americans Taylor Fritz and Frances Tiafoe were groomsmen and Reilly Opelka gave a best man speech that Paul called phenomenal [3][2]. Paul admitted afterwards that he had not expected to cry, and said watching Lorenze walk down the aisle was something he would never forget [2]. The honeymoon split the difference between them, with Nantucket for her and fishing for him, before he returned for the North American hard-court swing [2].
couples.style: Lorenze wore a custom strapless Carolina Herrera gown by Wes Gordon for the ceremony, changed into a backless Herrera dress with an oversized bow to cut the cake, and finished the night in a custom Wiederhoeft mini dress [3]. The setting did the rest: the formal gardens and stone architecture of Old Westbury, with made-to-order espresso martinis for the guests [3].
couples.culture: Lorenze built her following as a content creator and turned it into Dairy Boy, the lifestyle brand she founded [3]. The wedding became a tennis event of its own, with the ATP Tour covering the day and players across the tour sending congratulations, among them Opelka and Tiafoe [1]. Paul, a former world No. 8, went straight back to work on the hard courts after the honeymoon [2].

couples.story: Marie-Philip Poulin and Laura Stacey are linemates for the Montréal Victoire and teammates for Canada, and they have been together for more than seven years [1]. They announced their engagement in May 2023 and married in Quebec on 28 September 2024 [1][2]. Both were among the first players signed by Montréal when the PWHL began, and together they have won Olympic and world titles with Canada [2]. Their 2026 was a full cycle: Olympic silver at Milan Cortina in February, after which Stacey spoke of the two of them needing to be there for one another [5], then the Victoire's first Walter Cup in May, a 4-0 win over Ottawa that ended with the couple embracing on the ice and Poulin named playoff MVP [1][4]. In September Stacey was at Poulin's side on stage at the Prix Gémeaux [3], and both are on the Victoire roster for the 2026-27 season [6].
couples.style: Their public moments tend to happen in hockey gear, the Walter Cup embrace in Ottawa among them [1]. Off the ice, the Prix Gémeaux gala at Place des Arts in September 2026 gave them a red-carpet evening, Poulin arriving on Stacey's arm to a warm welcome from the Quebec television crowd [3]. Their 2024 wedding in Quebec was celebrated by teammates from club and country [2].
couples.culture: Poulin, Canada's captain and the 2026 Walter Cup playoff MVP [4], crossed into Quebec television's biggest night in September 2026, presenting two awards at the Prix Gémeaux with Stacey beside her [3]. The couple's openness during the PWHL's first seasons became part of the league's story of equity and inclusion [2]. Next up is a title defence: the Victoire open the 2026-27 season at Place Bell on 5 December [6].
